## Requirements: reduce E2E critical-path latency without weakening trusted Gates

### Background / measured baseline (2026-10-17, main)

Source owners:
- `.github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml`, `.github/workflows/ci-quality.yml`, `.github/workflows/acceptance-cases.yml`
- `design/scripts/design-gate.mjs`, `gates/checks/design-system-browser.sh`, `gates/checks/e2e-playwright.sh`
- `e2e/playwright.config.ts`, `e2e/globalSetup.ts`, `e2e/runner/runtime/full-stack.js`
- `web/package.json`, `web/vite.config.ts`

Real successful **main-push Full E2E** (run [39001292962](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39001292962), SHA `a458bdf13692406d5841d285471685f73a50c3c5`):

| Critical-path step | Wall time |
| --- | ---: |
| E2E npm/Chromium preparation | 25 s |
| Web `npm ci && npm run build` | 86 s |
| Rust server/agent `cargo build` | 10 s |
| `design-system-browser` | 156 s |
| Full E2E | 433 s |
| Overall job | ~745 s |

Corroboration: [39000423581](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39000423581) (Web 91s, Browser Gate 160s, Rust 11s, E2E 439s). A successful **PR with zero executed E2E tests** still took ~223s: [39002523040](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/39002523040) (Web 54s, Browser Gate 109s, Rust 7s, E2E 0s).

Job logs for 39001292962 show **`npm ci` installs 922 packages in ~59s**, while `tsc` takes roughly 10s and Vite production build reports 15.62s. Rust binary build is **not** the bottleneck.

**Proven duplicate execution:** the canonical design browser profile runs two sequential Playwright processes:
1. `ui-contract-assertions.spec.ts`, `ui-contract-matrix.spec.ts`, `ui-contract-web.spec.ts`;
2. `design-renderer-boundary.spec.ts`.

Each invokes Playwright `globalSetup` and creates its own real Server + Agent + Web + isolated tmux runtime. These four files also belong to the `e2e-playwright --all` suite, currently launched as a **third** Playwright process. Retain all contract assertions, but do not repeatedly execute them for the same exact SHA/scope.

### Goal

Shorten **wall-clock time to trusted blocking evidence**, not merely aggregate CPU seconds. First eliminate redundant browser execution, then make Web build preparation reusable across workflows and measure each component. A target of ~7–9 min for Full E2E and ~1–2 min for lightweight/not-required PRs is an **experimental target, not an Acceptance assertion**.

### Scope / ownership boundary

- **This Issue owns:** canonical Browser Design Gate + Full/Selected E2E **execution/evidence coalescing**, Web install/build artifact production/consumption, build/test critical-path instrumentation, and optional follow-on benchmark-driven browser sharding.
- **#1866 owns:** selected/not-required planning, skipping E2E-only prerequisites when safe, job-scoped Runtime Harness reuse and Acceptance Case state isolation/cleanup. Do not reimplement those in this Issue.
- **#1702** owns trusted Issue-selected E2E planning and per-ID assertion projection; **#1690** owns immutable Run Store governance and ingestion; **#1474** owns canonical E2E Runner; **#1616** owns remote/deployed verification.
- Respect `.github/AGENTS.md`: changes in `.github/workflows/*` land through an isolated **main-based PR directly to main**, merge commit (not squash/rebase).

### Phase A — eliminate redundant Browser Design execution (P0)

1. Keep **one canonical source** of Browser Design test IDs/paths in the design Gate owner; no duplicated test list silently drifting in Workflow/runner.
2. On **Full E2E** (including mandatory staging/main push), launch one real Playwright suite containing all browser tests **once**. Emit an independent **Browser Design Gate verdict** extracted from the real executed results of the canonical design subset, alongside the independent Full E2E verdict. The former cannot become Pass merely because the latter exits 0 without verifying matching IDs, executed assertions, non-skipped/non-flaky semantics and canonical selection digest.
3. On **Selected PR E2E**, execute the union of canonical mandatory Browser Design IDs and trusted Issue-selected IDs in **one Playwright process** only when equivalent coverage and provenance can be established. Produce **separately authenticated** design and per-issue-ID receipts. Adding design IDs must not inflate or silently satisfy Issue-selected IDs.
4. On **not-required PR**, still run any mandatory Browser Design checks; mark Issue-selected E2E as *not-required*, **never as Playwright Pass**. Preserve fallback/full behavior for malformed/untrusted/no-authorization plans.
5. Preserve `./gates/run design-system-browser` for standalone invocation and its fail-closed behavior. In the coalesced path, make the independent design result verifiable by trusted, canonical Gate/result code, not workflow-local heuristics or skipped required checks. Browser Design failure must remain blocking even if unrelated E2E files pass.
6. No hard-coded skip due only to a successful historical PR or a different SHA. Fail closed on absent/corrupt/mismatched reports, unexpected skips, 0 assertions, missing IDs, stale head, retries that violate gate contract, or test list drift.

### Phase B — Web build/install reuse and startup (P1)

1. Split observability of Web `npm ci`, `tsc`, `vite build`, `copy-font-licenses`; make E2E's production Web runtime artifacts reusable when safe without re-doing Quality Gate's independently required type-check verification.
2. Produce a **content-addressed build artifact** with exact target SHA and a verifiable manifest: product source/tree + relevant lockfiles + Node/npm/version/OS + build config/env non-secret inputs + `dist` checksums + producer workflow/run/attempt identity. No mutable tag/latest pointer, PR-controlled untrusted cache poisoning or unverified artifact-to-Pass promotion.
3. Consumers (`E2E / Tests` and eligible `Acceptance / Cases`) may reuse an existing **trusted, successful same-SHA build** or an explicitly equivalent input-tree digest after verification; otherwise **build locally**. A producer running concurrently must not create a blocking wait that makes cold-path critical time worse.
4. Important: `web/dist` alone is not a runnable Web test environment. Today `vite preview` relies on Web node_modules and proxies `/api` and WebSocket `/ws` to the exact local Server; preserve production bundle and proxy/WebSocket semantics. Either keep necessary dependencies installed or define and test a slim preview runtime with network/proxy parity before claiming `npm ci` can be skipped. E2E Chromium + browser runtime remains separately provisioned as necessary.
5. Cache dependency downloads correctly, report cache hit/miss and restore time; never use `node_modules` or cached `dist` as an authority for exact-SHA verified results. Keep original CI/quality checks meaningful.

### Phase C — metrics, benchmark, optional parallelism (P1/P2)

- Publish structured, bounded, non-sensitive per-run evidence: target SHA, event/stage, run/attempt, selection mode, total wall time, queue/start/end times, Web `npm ci`/`tsc`/Vite time, browser installation, Rust build, browser-design test counts/time, E2E tests/count/time, runtime provision count, artifact hit/miss/validation/fallback and Gate outcomes. No tokens/secrets/private WebSocket or terminal payloads.
- Compare before/after on **equivalent Full / Selected / not-required scopes** and report median and p90 across multiple CI runs plus Actions runner-minute impact. Measure whether bundling reduces critical path rather than just transferring cost into an upstream job.
- Measure slow Playwright specs using actual JSON test durations and retries. Only propose sharding after independently demonstrating state isolation (DB, home, tmux socket, ports, agent/session/browser contexts); `workers: 1` and `fullyParallel: false` must not be relaxed as a blind optimization. Any sharded results need trustworthy exact-SHA aggregate coverage before Pass.

### Non-goals / invariants

- Do not weaken/delete Browser Design contracts, screenshots, Full E2E, Quality Gate, or distinct exact-SHA acceptance/SC proof to claim a faster run.
- Do not downgrade staging/main push Full E2E to only Issue-selected tests. Preserve `--all`, `--id`, `--suite`, selected reporter and historic run/receipt consumers.
- No persistent shared mutable environment pool, shared DB, self-hosted/VPN Runner, or cross-workflow live process reuse.
- No Vite/TypeScript/toolchain rewrite without a measured bottleneck and correctness parity.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 On an exact-SHA **main push**, all canonical Browser Design files and Full E2E files run in **one Playwright process/runtime**, no duplicate spec execution; independent blocking Browser Design and Full E2E results both Pass with authenticated per-test execution evidence.
- [x] SC-02 On an exact PR head with selected IDs, the canonical design subset and Issue-selected IDs run as a deduplicated union in one process where supported, while result projection independently verifies each obligated ID; negative unknown/missing/skipped/zero-assertion tests are never falsely Pass.
- [ ] SC-03 On a real explicit `not-required` PR, mandatory Browser Design Gate still produces a real independently verifiable result, no unnecessary E2E runtime for unrelated selected tests, and Issue E2E remains *not-required* rather than fabricated Pass. Preserve #1866's prerequisite-selection ownership.
- [ ] SC-04 Canonical gate ownership, test catalog/manifest drift prevention and standalone `gates/run design-system-browser` all remain operational; inject Browser Design failures and missing/corrupt/foreign-SHA reports to verify fail-closed behavior in full and selected modes.
- [x] SC-05 A successful exact-SHA Web build artifact is reused by an eligible distinct consumer with checked manifest/artifact hashes and matching environment inputs; on miss/mismatch/untrusted producer it falls back to a fresh build (no stale result/evidence).
- [x] SC-06 Restored Web runtime serves the exact built frontend with matching HTTP, `/api` and `/ws` proxy behavior versus today's preview; fonts/licenses included; no false assumption that `dist` removes the need for preview dependencies.
- [ ] SC-07 Per-run measurements separate Web npm install/tsc/Vite, browser preparation/Design, Rust, E2E, runtime provisions, artifact reuse and queue/wall-clock; equivalent pre/post full, selected and not-required samples are linked to real CI runs, with both elapsed time and runner-minute accounting.
- [ ] SC-08 Quality Gate, Browser Design Gate, E2E (including main/staging push), trusted ingestion and post-merge Acceptance continue to Pass on genuine new SHA evidence; no existing #1702/#1690/#1866 contract is weakened.

## E2E Verification

### New
- none: CI/Gate execution and evidence orchestration, not a new browser-visible behavior; deterministic receipt negatives and real exact-SHA CI runs provide proof.

### Regression
- ui-contract-assertions
- ui-contract-matrix
- ui-contract-web
- design-renderer-boundary
- login
- session-lifecycle
- terminal-io
